sensitivity.title: Detection sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How readily the guardrail blocks. Low: only detect clear violations, minimizing unnecessary interruptions. Balanced (recommended): balance missed violations and false alarms. High: detect potential violations, even when the evaluation is uncertain
